notes.subject: תנינים
notes.rationale: Bikpela snek bilong solwara o bikpela pis nogut — ol tanima i no wankain: 'dragons', 'sea-monsters', 'jackals'.

notes.subject: פוררת / שברת
notes.rationale: Tupela tok bilong brukim i kamap klostu klostu — pasin bilong rait, em i lus long Tok Pisin.

notes.subject: to Yahwe
notes.rationale: Psalm i toktok daun long Yahwe, wanpela man i kotim nem bilong em.

translation: Yu brukim ⟨את⟩ solwara wantaim strong bilong yu; yu brukim ⟨את⟩ ol het bilong ol bikpela pis nogut bilong solwara long wara.

tokens.gloss: ol bikpela pis nogut bilong solwara
